warnings: Governing F1: a 0.60 x 0.60 pile cap on ONE prestressed concrete pile (เข็มคอนกรีตอัดแรง 1 ต้น, 2 ท่อนต่อ); the pile itself is specified in the notes block on the same sheet (I-section 0.22 x 0.22 m or Ø0.25 m, total length 21 m, ≥ 25 t safe load).
Mat printed as two leaders 'เหล็กตะแกรง 5-Ø15 มม งอฉากขึ้น' and 'เหล็ก 5-Ø15 มม. งอฉากขึ้น' — read as 5 bars each way; count = 10 per section 6b, printed text kept.

Edge tie 'เหล็ก 1-Ø12 มม. รัดโดยรอบ' recorded as stirrup count 1 (no spacing invented). The pedestal bars drawn inside the cap are labelled 'เหล็ก 6-Ø12 ม.ม.' with 'ปลอก 6มม@0.15ม คู่' — this disagrees with the column details on the same sheet (C1 below ground beam 6-Ø15, C2 4-Ø12); the column details govern the columns, the cap label is kept only in the note.
Depths printed: 0.40 cap thickness, 0.35 (to the top layer of the mat), 0.05 below the mat / pile head, 0.50 from ระดับดิน to the cap underside; lean concrete 1:3:5 0.10, compacted coarse sand 0.10.
